three.js 0.180.0 addons (examples/jsm): objects/Sky.js; postprocessing/EffectComposer, RenderPass, ShaderPass,
MaskPass, Pass, UnrealBloomPass; shaders/CopyShader, LuminosityHighPassShader, FXAAShader. Unmodified except that
`from 'three'` imports point at ../../three.module.min.js. Same MIT license as three.js (../LICENSE.txt).
Source: https://unpkg.com/three@0.180.0/examples/jsm/
